The '''Fremennik round shield''' is a piece of [[members]]-only armour. It requires level 25 [[Defence]] to wield. The Fremennik round shield can be obtained by making it with level 54 [[Woodcutting]], or from trading with another player.

To make a Fremennik round shield the player must first have started [[The Fremennik Isles]] quest (at least up to Traditional Fremennik Rites). The player needs two [[arctic pine logs]], a [[bronze nail]], and a [[rope]]. With a [[hammer]] in his/her inventory ([[Golden hammer (Golden Joystick reward)|golden hammer]] does work), the player should left-click on the tree stump that is north of the bridge in [[Neitiznot]], selecting the "Cut-Wood" option, then select ''Make Fremennik round shield''. Creating the shield will grant the player 34 [[Crafting]] experience.

The Fremennik round shield provides extra defence against the ranged stone attacks by [[Ice troll female|female]] [[ice troll]]s, reducing the damage to 10-20. Interestingly it also reduces the damage from the [[thrower troll]]s on [[Trollheim]] and [[Death Plateau]] and from [[Arrg]] during [[Troll Romance]], possible because of its design against range-based troll attacks. Its ranged defence and crush defence are a few points higher than the [[Adamant kiteshield]].
